conceptual_split_decision: Four actual mathematical components: incidence; finite graph component/cycle formulas; adjacency/nonbranching/link predicates; complete finite-profile and nontrivial path-shift witness. The independent degree-one count is retained, while whole AuditDatum/status snapshots/summaries/reports and their genuine finite proof terms remain exact archives.
premise_review: All23504 original and25138 organized bytes were separately read in full. A first combined display was truncated, so both complete original and organized files were explicitly reread separately before disposition.

Foreground vertices are exactly true raster cells. The selected foreground/background convention is edge/vertex; vertex adjacency includes distinctness and both coordinate-distance bounds. Degree<=2 is a finite nonbranching graph predicate, not a smooth or closed-square surface theorem.

Connected components and the displayed graph cycle-rank formula are direct finite-graph definitions. Higher graphBetti entries are definitionally zero. No theorem identifying this sequence with an external homology theory or proving a free fundamental-group interpretation is added.

The complete concrete semantics and controlledShift retain all actual predicates and proof fields; the shift changes the two endpoints while retaining the middle pixel and all stated foreground/background invariants. Every by decide remains an unexecuted source proof term.

AuditDatum/RasterTopologySnapshot/SurgeryInvariantReport mix known/notApplicable/notEstablished metadata, genus/orientability/fixed-point/equilibrium status and production report framing. They and the five actual report equality/count proofs remain whole archived; boundaryComponentCount is an independently complete mathematical function. No field is removed to create a narrower report.
